assets.name: camp
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide cinematic hero background for the Rewards page of Survival Academy, a premium dark teal and amber survival learning dashboard. Generate ONE ultra-wide 3:1 landscape photograph, 1920 by 640 requested. Vast snow-dusted rugged mountains at sunset, layered dark evergreen forests, a warm orange-lit small canvas tent on a rocky overlook at the RIGHTMOST QUARTER, a brass camping lantern and weathered outdoor backpack near the tent. No people. Moody teal-black shadows, dramatic warm amber sunset and tent light, realistic editorial outdoor photography. The left half and central lower band must be especially dark and visually quiet for a large level badge and white title to be placed by the website. CRITICAL CROP-SAFE COMPOSITION: tent, lantern and backpack relatively small, entirely within the middle vertical 40 percent of the image, y=30% to y=70%, on the right; ample sky above and dark rocks below. Mountain peaks along the central horizontal band so a shallow panoramic web header can crop sky and foreground without cutting important subjects. No words, text, lettering, logos, watermark, badges, UI, numbers or frames.

assets.name: gold
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent background 3D achievement medal frame for a survival learning application. One centered symmetrical HEXAGONAL SHIELD badge with an elegant metallic bronze and gold beveled double rim, dark charcoal slightly textured blank metal inset face, and gold laurel branches embracing the outside lower left and right edges. Front view, no perspective tilt. Premium realistic 3D game achievement craftsmanship, brushed gold edges, subtle engraved fine lines and amber rim highlights, dark face for a white or gold live icon or number to be overlaid by the website. Shield points downward slightly at the bottom, with six sides; badge silhouette like a sturdy expedition insignia, not a round medal. Badge fills 80 percent of a square canvas with generous transparent padding on every edge, fully visible laurels, no cropping, no background plate. Soft realistic depth and highlights. Real transparent background, alpha cutout. No text, lettering, logos, watermark, ribbons, UI, sparkle stars or additional objects.
